notablePrerequisites: Elenda's power is at least 4 plus its commander tax.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
Choose to return Elenda from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to its power.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Blade of the Bloodchief's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Elenda.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {W/B}.
When the Vampire dies, Elenda and Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting three +1/+1 counters on Elenda.
Repeat from step 6 for each Vampire token.
Repeat from step 1.
